careTasks.title: 🗓️ Tasks & intervals
careTasks.help: All recurring work at a glance: your own tasks such as water changes or filter care plus, added automatically, the measuring cycle and manual fertilizers. The next due date follows the latest matching entry.
careTasks.empty: No recurring work yet. Add a task, a measuring cycle in the aquarium settings or a manual fertilizer.
careTasks.typeHelp: Plan fertilizing in the fertilizer section and water tests with the aquarium's measuring cycle.
careTasks.customTitlePlaceholder: e.g. 30 % water change with RO water
careTasks.startHelp: This date applies until the first completion; afterwards the interval counts from the latest logbook entry.
careTasks.timeHelp: Without a time the task appears as an all-day event in the calendar.
careTasks.completeConfirm: Record “{name}” as done in the logbook now?
careTasks.deleteConfirm: Delete task “{name}”? Logbook entries are kept.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.help: Measuring cycles, manual fertilizers and recurring tasks of the selected aquariums (own and shared with write access) as calendar events.
calendar.downloadHelp: One-time export of all events until the end of {to}. Later changes only appear after importing again – use CalDAV for automatic updates.
calendar.caldavHelp: Add these credentials as a CalDAV account on your phone or computer. The calendar is read-only and updates automatically.
calendar.passwordHelp: The password was generated automatically and only works for the calendar, not for signing in to the app. Only your account can access your calendar with these credentials.
calendar.ios: iPhone/iPad: Settings → Calendar → Accounts → Add Account → Other → CalDAV account; enter server, username and password.
calendar.android: Android: e.g. in DAVx⁵ add an account with “Login with URL and user name” and use the server address.
calendar.desktop: Thunderbird, macOS Calendar and others: create a new network/CalDAV calendar with the calendar address.
calendar.regenerateConfirm: Generate a new CalDAV password? Devices that are already set up must sign in with the new password afterwards.
calendar.offline: Calendar access and download require an internet connection.
calendar.aquariumsHelp: Choose which aquariums appear in the download and the CalDAV calendar. New aquariums are included automatically; the selection is saved immediately.
calendar.aquariumsEmpty: No own aquariums or aquariums shared with write access.
calendar.noneSelected: No aquarium selected – the download and CalDAV calendar stay empty.

lighting.title: Lighting
lighting.empty: No lighting settings yet. Enter your light's channel levels, light times and sunrise/sunset.
lighting.preview: Approximate mixed colour at full brightness
lighting.channelsHelp: Channel levels in percent (0 = channel off, 100 = full power)
lighting.rampHelp: How long the light dims up after “Light on” and down before “Light off”. A light day across midnight is possible.
lighting.notePlaceholder: e.g. fixture model or midday break
lighting.deleteConfirm: Delete the lighting settings of this aquarium?

socialProfile.settingsHelp: With a social profile, others can click your username in the Social area and see your profile picture, username and shared posts. More profile details will follow later.
socialProfile.publicNotice: Your profile with profile picture and username is public and reachable without signing in. Which posts appear depends on their own visibility: guests only see your public posts, signed-in members of this server also your internal ones.
socialProfile.disabledNotice: Your profile is disabled. Your posts stay visible in the feed, but your username does not lead to a profile page.
socialProfile.previewDisabled: Preview: your social profile is disabled and only visible to you.
socialProfile.offline: Social profiles require an internet connection.
socialProfile.guestNote: You only see public posts. Sign in to see internal posts as well.
socialProfile.notFoundText: This profile does not exist or is not enabled.
